description: This file defines the AccountHelper class which provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting general ledger accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It includes methods for creating different types of accounts (asset, income, expense, liability, equity) and fetching accounts with their running balances. It also wraps calls to external APIs via the Fineract client and utility methods.
